# Third-party data

The regex library code is original and licensed under Apache-2.0 (see
LICENSE). Two kinds of third-party data ship in this repository.

## Unicode Character Database

`src/unicode/ucd.bin` is generated by `tools/gen_unicode.py` from the Unicode
Character Database, version 15.1.0. The data was converted into a compact
binary layout (sets of code point ranges and case folding orbits); no other
change was made to its meaning.
